dim_restaurant_unique.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = COUNT(DISTINCT restaurant_id) FROM dim_restaurant

inspection_key_unique.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = COUNT(DISTINCT inspection_key) FROM fct_inspection

violation_key_unique.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = COUNT(DISTINCT violation_key) FROM fct_violation

complaint_key_unique.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = COUNT(DISTINCT complaint_id) FROM fct_complaint

weather_key_unique.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = COUNT(DISTINCT weather_key) FROM fct_weather

inspection_restaurant_not_null.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 0 FROM fct_inspection WHERE restaurant_id IS NULL

inspection_restaurant_relationship.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 0 FROM fct_inspection f LEFT JOIN dim_restaurant d USING (restaurant_id) WHERE d.restaurant_id IS NULL

violation_inspection_relationship.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 0 FROM fct_violation v LEFT JOIN fct_inspection i USING (inspection_key) WHERE i.inspection_key IS NULL

risk_tier_accepted_values.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 0 FROM rpt_restaurant_risk WHERE risk_tier NOT IN ('LOW','MEDIUM','HIGH','CRITICAL')

nonnegative_inspection_scores.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 0 FROM fct_inspection WHERE score < 0
